messages:
mira: opened a hotfix docs PR to add the incident permalink + a short customer workaround for last night's model fallback. need 1-2 reviewers and a green preview before the 09:00 customer sync.
harry: drop the PR link?
mira: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/537  edits: add status.redwood.com permalink under /operational/incidents, Known issue: KV cache invalidation on autoscaler failover, short ops steps, and JS/Python/Go SDK retry examples + migration note.
lina: i can review the prose. heads-up: docs build has been tripping the link-checker recently.
docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #537  error: link-checker: broken external link in incidents/incidents.md -> https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover-5 (HTTP 404). Full CI log: https://ci.redwood.com/build/10532
mira: hmm that status permalink should exist. is the incident slug different?
sre_nina: the public status URL has a slightly different slug for the follow-up incident. correct link: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover-followup. please use that.
mira: updated link and pushed. also added a small ops-only snippet: how to clear KV cache gracefully via admin API.
harry: nit on SDK samples: please mark code fences and use timeout_ms for Python, explicit backoff for JS, and add a Go example showing context with timeout. e.g. Go snippet:
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 2*time.Minute)
defer cancel()
resp, err := client.Generate(ctx, GenerateParams{Model: "redwood-7b", Prompt: "..."})
```
mira: added the Go example and updated other snippets. pushed.
docs-bot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview-537--docs.redwood.com  please review rendered Known Issue and SDK samples.
deploy-bot: preview build shows warning: including internal ops link in public docs; confirm if we should expose the admin API snippet.
sre_nina: admin API snippet is ops-only. please move the admin API example to an include under /internal-runbooks and reference it from the public doc with a redacted placeholder.
mira: moved the admin snippet to internal include and added a placeholder note in public doc: "Ops-only: contact SRE for admin cache-clear steps." pushed.
docs-bot: rebuild triggered for PR #537  status: in-progress.
ops-bot: queued promotion to staging for PR #537.
support_maya: can you add a one-line customer-facing blurb we can paste into Support KB? suggested: "We experienced a brief model failover leading to transient errors; please retry after 2 minutes. View incident details: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover-followup"
mira: added the customer blurb under "Customer note".
harry: quick CI nit: broken link-checker may still fail on the internal include reference. add an exceptions entry to docs/config/links.yml for the internal-runbooks path.
mira: added links.yml exception and pushed.
docs-bot: final docs-build succeeded for PR #537.
merge-bot: all approvals present for PR #537. running final CI checks before merge.
deploy-bot: promotion to staging completed; staging smoke looks normal.
merge-bot: PR #537 merged into main by mira at 1768008120. auto-changelog entry queued.
support_maya: thanks  i'll paste the customer blurb into the KB and notify support rotation.
mira: thanks team. i'll open a backport PR to /ops for the internal runbook and add a short release-note entry."
